answer.reason: Jahaz is where Sihon came out and fought Israel and was defeated, an event the summary does not state.

clauses.english: was where King Sihon gathered his people and fought against Israel
clauses.quote: Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, to fight at Jahaz.

doubts: The verses naming Jahaza/Jahazah/Jahzah in the lists of Reuben's cities and the Levitical cities only list it, so they were left out.
The defeat of Sihon is stated in the verses after the battle, not as happening at Jahaz itself, so only the battle is claimed.
